title: O Jesuski Hupuji Ho
chord: C · G · Am · F · C · G · F · C
lyrics:
Jesus do haholonganta
Ai digarari do dosanta
Tobusta do mudarNa i
Daging dohot tondinami
Tu Ho Jesus hulehon hami
Ai sonang do di tanganMi

Sai jalo hami on Hami huriaMon AnakkonMu
Asi rohaM, Denggan basaM
Tumpakkon ma tu huriaM
